text:
Maya (PMM): quick sync to finalize battlecard blurbs + routing for next benchmark webinar. want paste-ready replies for AE/SE and simple routing flags.
Raj - Sales: field needs 1-line threat + 1-line rebuttal per competitor. also a 15s host line.
Priya - GTM: Routing rules: projected_spend_usd>=3000 -> AE; mentions [on-prem,VPC,SOC2] -> AE+security; trial_tpm>6000 -> SE. region by IP.
Noor - Benchmarks: public guidance: no absolute multiples. publish indexed p50/p95/p99 bands and a short methodology. internal appendix for raw numbers.
Maya (PMM): good. propose quick soundbites: "Predictable token economics across hosted, dedicated, and private" and "API simplicity + infra-grade predictability".
Raj - Sales: paste-snippet for hosted API claim: "Hosted endpoints are easy; but at scale they spike. Redwood smooths p99 via batching + routing and gives SLA visibility."
Priya - GTM: sample webhook payload for SFDC (minimal): {"email":"lead@cust.com","proj_spend_usd":4200,"flags":["VPC","embeddings"],"route":"ae-eu"}
routing-bot: :white_check_mark: rule saved: spend>=3000 -> tag:ae; keywords [on-prem,VPC,SOC2] -> tag:sec_review
Noor - Benchmarks: include methodology note in battlecard: sustained steady-state load, warm KV, mixed prompt lengths, same model families.
Maya (PMM): AE voicemail (15s) draft: "Hi {name}, Maya from Redwood. We help teams avoid surprise inference bills and stabilize latency. Quick 15 to chat?"
Raj - Sales: host 15s: "We'll show how teams cut effective token spend while keeping latency predictable, plus when to pick Dedicated vs Private."
Priya - GTM: I'll map flags to SFDC queues and run routing tests.
Maya (PMM): action items: Noor -> public blurb + appendix markers; Priya -> SFDC mapping; Raj -> AE paste-snippets + host line. I'll assemble v1 and share by 9am tomorrow. :rocket:
